patch_description: A four-parameter, symmetry-regularized Ising ansatz on a Möbius-ladder interaction graph. Shared parameters impose a strong inductive bias suited to small training sets, while nearest-neighbor and antipodal ZZ interactions propagate both local and global correlations across all eight qubits. Placing the shared RY mixer last ensures each repeated block converts learned phase correlations into measurable populations. Compared with the seed, this reduces distinct ansatz parameters from 24 to 4, lowers gate count, improves graph connectivity, and should converge faster with less overfitting.
